name: aging-gracefully
vibe: aging gracefully: old hands, silver hair, long love, generations, dancing and small joys; tender, warm, a little funny
_source: only the 18 pins in the 'aging gracefully' section of the user's Pinterest board kholthaus8/lit-ass-grandmas (read from the section's public page), whole and uncropped
_search_phrase: aging gracefully aesthetic / growing old together

pile._look: one continuous pile on warm taupe: the first photo lands dead centre and straight, the rest land around and over it at the same size, tilted a few degrees like prints laid on a table; thin 6 px off-white borders, soft shadow; the last photo lands dead centre, straight and bigger
pile._spots: the second and third photos land below-right and above-left of the opening photo, so the hook stays in view for the first seconds

_tempo_comment: steady 100 BPM, one photo per beat (0.6 s). One pile of 17 photos that never clears; each photo fades in softly in place over 6 frames (0.2 s) and is fully there on the beat, then never moves. The finished pile holds 3 beats (1.8 s). 20 beats = 12.0 s = 5 bars. No song: main MP4 has a kick beat guide; _silent.mp4 for posting with a ~100 BPM TikTok sound.
_order: 17 of the section's 18 pins. Hook: the friends' mirror selfie, dead centre and straight; ends on the windblown couple selfie, dead centre, straight and bigger. Black-and-white photos, hands, the two dances and the two family photos are spread apart. No two photos of the same kind back to back, including around the loop.
_soft: three small sources are used here because pile tiles are smaller than full-screen: two-eyes-young-old-bw (404 px tall), reading-tent-grandkids (480 px wide), bed-cuddle-laughing (525 px)

not_used.gma-i-like-getting-older-collage: carries a photographer's printed credit along its edge and is only 390 px wide
